limitations: This is a proposed task-local prototype and is not wired into selected production generation or approval metadata.
Evidence covers two settings at one retained seed, not every lawful component scene.
The extended grammar intentionally contains two repeated crop classes; canonical production scenes continue to contain exactly one class repeated twice.
Threshold two inherits the canonical first-qualifying reversed-scan tie break; the retained placement makes that choice explicit rather than claiming order invariance.
Finite demonstrations distinguish the declared threshold rival, not every possible crop-selection rule.

parameter.input_constraints: each retained scene has one crop exactly twice later in canonical scan order, one different crop exactly three times earlier, and two unique distractors
parameter.meaning: minimum number of exact colored component-crop occurrences required
parameter.name: minimum_occurrences

2.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((visited (make-hash))
                  (obj-grids (list)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when
                     (and (!= (at g r c) 0) (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                     (let ((cells (list)))
                       (let bfs
                            ((queue (list (list r c))))
                            (unless
                              (null? queue)
                              (let ((cur (car queue)))
                                (cond
                                  ((hash-has-key? visited cur) (bfs (cdr queue)))
                                  ((or
                                     (< (first cur) 0)
                                     (>= (first cur) h)
                                     (< (second cur) 0)
                                     (>= (second cur) w)) (bfs (cdr queue)))
                                  ((zero? (at g (first cur) (second cur))) (bfs (cdr queue)))
                                  (else (hash-set! visited cur #t)
                                        (set! cells (cons cur cells))
                                        (let ((cr (first cur))
                                              (cc (second cur)))
                                          (bfs (append (cdr queue)
                                                       (list (list (- cr 1) cc)
                                                             (list (+ cr 1) cc)
                                                             (list cr (- cc 1))
                                                             (list cr (+ cc 1)))))))))))
                       (let* ((rs (map first cells))
                              (cs (map second cells))
                              (r1 (min-list rs))
                              (c1 (min-list cs))
                              (r2 (max-list rs))
                              (c2 (max-list cs))
                              (sub (build-grid (+ 1 (- r2 r1))
                                               (+ 1 (- c2 c1))
                                               (rr cc)
                                               (at g (+ r1 rr) (+ c1 cc)))))
                         (set! obj-grids (cons sub obj-grids))))))
             (let ((n (length obj-grids)))
               (let find-dup
                    ((i 0))
                    (if (>= i n)
                        (build-grid 1 1 (r c) 0)
                        (let ((gi (list-ref obj-grids i)))
                          (if (> (count-if (lambda (gj)
                                             (and
                                               (= (rows gi) (rows gj))
                                               (= (cols gi) (cols gj))
                                               (let check
                                                    ((rr 0))
                                                    (cond
                                                      ((>= rr (rows gi)) #t)
                                                      ((let col-check
                                                            ((cc 0))
                                                            (cond
                                                              ((>= cc (cols gi)) #t)
                                                              ((= (at gi rr cc)
                                                                  (at gj rr cc)) (col-check (+ cc 1)))
                                                              (else #f))) (check (+ rr 1)))
                                                      (else #f)))))
                                           obj-grids)
                                 1)
                              gi
                              (find-dup (+ i 1)))))))))))
